title: Time Expressions and Clock Times
definition: German uses specific expressions to ask and tell the time, talk about daily schedules, and describe when events happen. Official time often uses the 24-hour clock; everyday speech also uses informal expressions such as halb acht.

rules.title: Ask and tell the time
rules.explanation: Ask Wie spät ist es? or Wie viel Uhr ist es? Use Es ist ... to answer.

rules.title: Informal time expressions
rules.explanation: German halb refers to the half-hour before the next hour. Viertel nach means quarter past; Viertel vor means quarter to.

rules.title: At what time?
rules.explanation: Use um before a clock time.

examples.german: Der Unterricht beginnt um neun Uhr.
Ich gehe um halb sieben zur Arbeit.

rules.title: Parts of the day
rules.explanation: Use am with many parts of the day, but in der Nacht for at night.

rules.title: Useful schedule phrases
rules.explanation: Use von ... bis for a time range and gegen for approximately.

examples.german: Ich arbeite von neun bis fünf.
examples.english: I work from nine to five.

examples.german: Der Bus kommt gegen zehn Uhr.
examples.english: The bus arrives around ten o'clock.

examples.german: Ich stehe jeden Tag um sieben Uhr auf.
examples.english: I get up at seven every day.

comparison.formal: Es ist siebzehn Uhr fünfundvierzig. — It is 17:45.
comparison.informal: Es ist Viertel vor sechs. — It is 5:45.

common_mistakes.explanation: Halb acht means halfway to eight.

mastery_goal: You can ask for and tell the time, understand common informal clock expressions, and describe a daily schedule.
